schemas.name: code
schemas.description: Execute JavaScript. Call this tool with a code STRING and engine="node". The external function name is code. tools.NAME are JavaScript functions available inside that string only. Discover: {"engine":"node","code":"text(await tools.list())"}. Describe a tool: {"engine":"node","code":"text(await tools.tool_describe({name: "semantic_query"}))"}. Retained Joern workflow inside JavaScript: const index=await tools.semantic_index({}); use index.analyses[].id. Map entries/exits: await tools.semantic_query({analysis:id,operation:"flowmap",from:{name:method},all:true}). Trace values: await tools.semantic_trace({analysis:id,from:{kind:"method",name:method,parameter:input},to:{kind:"call",name:sink,argument:1},assumptions:[{expression:predicate,holds:false}],all:true}). Full map fields: flowMap.nodes, methods, assumptions, complete, proof. Full trace fields: sides[].data.paths, sides[].control.paths, proof. Each path has assumptionEvaluation.status. Poll running jobs on the same tool with {job,waitMs:1000,all:true}. Return selected facts and view links. all:true expands retained fields, never proves complete source coverage or runtime behavior.
